description:
## [1.5.0](https://github.com/ZoomSass/Mighty-Morphing/compare/v1.4.5...v1.5.0) (2026-11-15)

### ✨ New Features

* Media enhancements patch for Classic Joey ([92da974](https://github.com/ZoomSass/Mighty-Morphing/commit/92da974c2407d24677c3495f8611f1671d724a76))

patches.name: Arctic Shift restore
patches.description: [v1.4.5: Link preview fix.] Removed and deleted comments, and removed posts on the comments screen, get an Arctic Shift Restore button that brings back the archived text. Nothing is fetched until you tap it. Works with Modern UI or Classic. Turn it on in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings. Initial release, please report any issues or suggestions for improvements.

patches.name: Backup and restore
patches.description: Save Joey and Morphe settings to a file and restore them later, including splash, theme, fonts, comments, and show and hide. Log in to the same Reddit account before restoring subscriptions. Access via Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Disable tooltips
patches.description: Turns off the first-run tips Joey shows.

patches.name: Dismiss without tearing
patches.description: Swiping a photo away to close it looks smooth instead of tearing.

patches.name: Editor image and GIF upload
patches.description: Uploads images and GIFs to Reddit directly when adding comments. Both can be uploaded via the image button. Also adds keyboard gif auto upload to reddit (click markdown in editor (far left icon) to enable keyboard gif support).

patches.name: Fix collapsed replies
patches.description: Loads replies that stay hidden when Reddit will not open them. Based on the Patcheddit fix.

patches.name: Fix login page
patches.description: Makes Reddit's login page load and work properly inside Joey, and clears the cookie banner out of the way.

patches.name: Inline comment media
patches.description: Shows GIFs, pictures, subreddit emojis and Reddit videos in comments instead of links. Tap to open, drag left or right to resize, and scroll past them as normal. YouTube links use a 16:9 preview with the title. Extra settings in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Log in with your own client ID
patches.description: Lets Joey log in with another app's client ID, for when Joey's own login stops working. Normal option here is to sign in to RedReader once, then paste the App ID from Reddit's "you authorized an app" email into this patch's settings in expert mode.

options.description: The App ID from Reddit's "you authorized an app" email. Leave empty to keep Joey's own login.
Has to match the app the ID came from. The default works for RedReader.
Sent with Reddit requests. The default is RedReader's.

patches.name: Media enhancements
patches.description: [v1.5.0: New. The Modern UI media features, now as their own patch so Classic Joey can have them too. Nothing changes for existing users; Modern UI already includes all of this.] Downloads with your own file names and folder, full screen media, optionally opening without controls, an album viewer with thumbnails, grid and captions, and swiping albums closed. All on by default; each can be turned off in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Modern UI
patches.description: [v1.5.0: The media features (downloads, full screen media, album viewer and more) are now shared with the new Media enhancements patch, so Classic Joey users can have them too. Nothing changes for existing users. Media options now have their own section in Morphe Settings.] [v1.4.0: Post buttons & menu editor for the post bar and ⋮ menu. Full screen media, optionally opening without controls. New album viewer with thumbnails, grid and captions. Separate Modern fonts. Sidebar subreddit search keyboard fixed. Performance improvements, comparably smooth to Joey or better.] A cleaner layout for Joey, on by default, with a choice of themes. Joey's own themes and colours are off while it's on, and Classic Joey can be switched back on any time. Posts use one compact list with adjustable post buttons, info line and image style, including whether opened posts show the full picture. Settings in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Open Reddit share links
patches.description: Opens modern Reddit share links directly to the right post or comment in Joey instead of loading the web page. To open Reddit links from other apps, make sure all links are ticked in Android Settings -> Apps -> Joey -> Open by default.

patches.name: RedGifs with sound
patches.description: RedGifs clips play with their sound, in HD when it's available.

patches.name: Search auto open keyboard
patches.description: Opens the keyboard automatically for homepage search and comment search. The Enter and Search keys start the search.

patches.name: Seasonal sidebar banner
patches.description: Shows a picture in the sidebar header that changes with the season, or one you choose. If you set it back to Joey's image, any picture Joey had already saved is still there and gets used again.

patches.name: Show/Hide
patches.description: Choose which comment editor buttons, sidebar entries, subreddit toolbar items and post actions are shown, and drag to reorder them. What doesn't fit on a post goes in its menu. Adjust in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Skip ads and checks
patches.description: Removes ads everywhere and also drops the Play Store install check and crash reporting.

patches.name: Splash Screen
patches.description: [v1.4.0: Match theme keeps your chosen animation.] Logo inspired by u/otheast. Logo, colours and animation can be customised, follow your theme, or the animation can be turned off, in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Subreddit filter options
patches.description: Adds a subreddit suffix filter and lets you toggle subreddit filters on or off without deleting them. Configure in Joey - Settings - Filters, or from the feed Filter out posts menu.
